            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": ".venv/bin/pip install -e ."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "# 2. 配置（勿提交含本机路径的文件）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86,
            "text": "sudo mkdir -p /etc/smartcode"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "sudo cp projects/registry.example.yaml /etc/smartcode/registry.yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "sudo vim /etc/smartcode/registry.yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "# 3. systemd（见 deploy/smartcode-browser.service）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "sudo cp deploy/smartcode-browser.service /etc/systemd/system/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "sudo systemctl enable --now smartcode-browser"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "**依赖**：Python 3.11+、系统 &#96;grep&#96;（全局符号回退与查用法）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97,
            "text": "**安全**：服务无内置鉴权，能读注册表指向的任意源码。公网暴露请加 VPN / Nginx 反代 + 认证，或 SSH 隧道："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "ssh -L 8780:127.0.0.1:8780 user@server"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103,

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# SmartCode Browser · 级联代码浏览器"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "语言无关的 Web 代码导航工具：点击函数里的**蓝色调用**，在右侧级联展开其定义，形成可视化调用树。专为跨文件追踪调用链设计。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "## 功能"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "| 操作 | 说明 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "|------|------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "| 调用 → 定义 | 点击蓝色 &#96;.ref&#96;，级联打开被调函数（多实现时真实现优先） |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "| 变量 → 声明 | 点击标识符，局部变量在本面板闪烁，全局/字段/枚举打开声明 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "| 查找用法 | Alt/Ctrl+点击 或 右键，弹出用法列表 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "| 会话恢复 | 刷新后自动恢复上次代码树 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "| 命名标签 | 顶栏「保存到标签」，一键恢复探索路径 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "## 支持语言"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "C/C++ · Python · Java · Scala/Chisel（新增语言 = 实现一个 tree-sitter 适配器）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "## 快速开始"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "git clone https://github.com/\u003cyour-username\u003e/smartcode-browser.git"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "cd smartcode-browser"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "python3.11 -m venv .venv"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": ".venv/bin/pip install -U pip"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": ".venv/bin/pip install -e ."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "# 配置要浏览的代码库"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "cp projects/registry.example.yaml projects/registry.yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "# 编辑 projects/registry.yaml，把 root 改成你的代码库绝对路径"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "# 启动（默认 127.0.0.1:8765）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": ".venv/bin/smartcode-browser"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "# 或指定端口"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "SMARTCODE_BROWSER_PORT=8780 .venv/bin/smartcode-browser"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "浏览器打开 &#96;http://127.0.0.1:8765&#96;。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "## 环境变量"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "|------|------|------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_BROWSER_HOST&#96; | &#96;127.0.0.1&#96; | 监听地址 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_BROWSER_PORT&#96; | &#96;8765&#96; | 端口 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_BROWSER_REGISTRY&#96; | 见 README | 项目注册表 YAML |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_CURSOR_CLI_BIN&#96; | &#96;cursor-agent&#96; | cursor-agent 可执行文件路径 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_CURSOR_MODEL&#96; | &#96;composer-2.5&#96; | cursor-agent 使用的模型 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_CURSOR_TIMEOUT&#96; | &#96;600&#96; | 单次 AI 分析超时（秒） |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "| &#96;SMARTCODE_BROWSER_CACHE&#96; | &#96;~/.cache/smartcode-browser&#96; | 符号索引磁盘缓存目录；设为 &#96;off&#96; 禁用 |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "AI 分析依赖 **cursor-agent** 及其登录态，请先安装 CLI 并执行 &#96;cursor-agent login&#96;（无需配置 OpenAI API Key）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "注册表查找顺序：&#96;SMARTCODE_BROWSER_REGISTRY&#96; → &#96;./projects/registry.yaml&#96; → 包旁 &#96;projects/registry.yaml&#96; → &#96;/etc/smartcode/registry.yaml&#96; → 内置演示（浏览本包源码）。"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 56
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./README.md",
        "signatures": {}

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"SmartCode 级联代码浏览器 —— 语言无关、项目无关的 Web 代码导航工具。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;models&#96;&#96;    符号 / 引用 / 定义"

          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;adapters&#96;&#96;  可插拔 tree-sitter 语言适配器"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;registry&#96;&#96;  多项目注册表"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;index&#96;&#96;     跨文件符号索引 + 全局 grep 回退"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;engine&#96;&#96;    引擎（供 Web API 调用）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;server&#96;&#96;    FastAPI 后端 + 原生前端"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "__version__ = \"0.1.0\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "__all__ = [\"models\", \"adapters\", \"registry\", \"index\", \"engine\"]"
          }
        ],
        "range": {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"FastAPI 应用：把 CodeEngine 暴露成一组语言无关的 JSON 接口，并托管前端。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "接口设计刻意保持最小且无状态——级联导航的「树状态」全部放在前端，"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "后端只回答三类问题：有哪些项目 / 搜什么符号 / 打开某个符号是什么内容。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "这样后端可水平扩展，前端布局逻辑也不受后端约束。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "from pathlib import Path"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "import asyncio"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "from ..engine import CodeEngine"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "from .llm import chat_analyze, llm_configured, llm_settings"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "_STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "class AiChatRequest(BaseModel):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    project: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    file: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    function_name: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    start_line: int"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    end_line: int = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    signature: str = \"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "    source: str = Field(..., max_length=120_000)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "    selected_text: str = Field(\"\", max_length=32_000)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    question: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=16_000)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    history: list[dict[str, str]] = Field(default_factory=list)"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "    chat_id: str = \"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "def create_app(engine: CodeEngine | None = None) -\u003e FastAPI:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "    \"\"\"构造 FastAPI 应用。engine 可注入，便于测试。\"\"\""
          }
        ],
        "range": {

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"多项目注册表。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "一个「项目」= 一个代码库根目录 + 主语言 + 可选索引子路径。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "同一浏览器可在 Linux 内核 / Chipyard / 自研项目间切换，引擎与前端无需改动。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "注册表来源（按优先级）："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "1) 环境变量 SMARTCODE_BROWSER_REGISTRY 指向的 YAML"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "2) 当前工作目录下的 projects/registry.yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "3) 源码/安装包旁的 projects/registry.yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "4) /etc/smartcode/registry.yaml（常见部署路径）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "5) 若都不存在，回退到「浏览本包源码」的演示项目"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "import os"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass, field"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "from pathlib import Path"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "import yaml"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "@dataclass"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "class Project:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    \"\"\"单个可浏览项目的配置。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    id: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    name: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    root: Path"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    language: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    include_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "    extra_languages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "    exclude_dirs: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    def exists(self) -\u003e bool:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "        return self.root.is_dir()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "    def to_dict(self) -\u003e dict:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "        return {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "            \"id\": self.id,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "            \"name\": self.name,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "            \"root\": str(self.root),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "            \"language\": self.language,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "            \"include_paths\": self.include_paths,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "            \"extra_languages\": self.extra_languages,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "            \"exists\": self.exists(),"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "        }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "_DEFAULT_EXCLUDES = ["
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "    \".git\", \".hg\", \".svn\", \"node_modules\","
          }
        ],

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"代码浏览器引擎：串联注册表、适配器、索引，向 Web API 暴露语言无关方法。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "这是 API 唯一需要打交道的对象。它的方法对应前端的核心动作："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;list_projects&#96;&#96;     顶部项目下拉"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;search&#96;&#96;            符号搜索框"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;open_symbol&#96;&#96;       打开一个函数/方法 → Panel 内容（源码 + 可点击引用）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;resolve&#96;&#96;           点击某个引用 → 候选定义（供级联开新 Panel）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "引擎本身不感知任何具体语言；语言差异全部封装在适配器里。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "from .index import SymbolIndex"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "from .models import Definition, ResolvedReference, Symbol, SymbolDetail"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "from .registry import Project, ProjectRegistry"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "class CodeEngine:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "    \"\"\"多项目代码导航引擎（每个项目一份惰性索引，进程内缓存）。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "    def __init__(self, registry: ProjectRegistry | None = None) -\u003e None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "        self.registry = registry or ProjectRegistry()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "        self._indexes: dict[str, SymbolIndex] = {}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    # --- 索引获取 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    def _index(self, project_id: str) -\u003e SymbolIndex:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "        if project_id not in self._indexes:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "            project = self.registry.get(project_id)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "            self._indexes[project_id] = SymbolIndex(project, project_id)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "        return self._indexes[project_id]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    # --- 项目 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "    def list_projects(self) -\u003e list[dict]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "        return [p.to_dict() for p in self.registry.list()]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "    def project_stats(self, project_id: str) -\u003e dict:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "        return self._index(project_id).stats"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "    # --- 搜索 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "    def search(self, project_id: str, query: str, limit: int = 40) -\u003e list[dict]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "        index = self._index(project_id)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "        return [s.to_dict() for s in index.search(query, limit)]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "    # --- 打开符号 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "    def open_symbol("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "        self,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "        project_id: str,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "        file: str,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "        name: str | None = None,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "        line: int | None = None,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "    ) -\u003e SymbolDetail | None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "        "
          }
        ],

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 348
          },
          "startPosition": {}

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "/*"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": " * SmartCode 代码浏览器前端"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": " *"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": " * 核心是一棵「导航树」：每个 Panel 记录它从哪个父 Panel 的哪一行点进来。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": " * 渲染时按 depth（到根的距离）分列，同一父节点下的多个分支在同列纵向堆叠，"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": " * 从而实现「A→B→C 和 A→B→E 并列」的级联效果（IDE 难以做到）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": " */"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "const state = {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "  project: null,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "  panels: new Map(), // id -\u003e panel 对象"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "  order: [],         // 维持插入顺序，决定同列内的堆叠次序"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "  seq: 0,            // panel id 自增"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "  _restoring: false, // 恢复会话时跳过自动保存，避免写入半成品"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "  aiConfigured: false,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "  aiModel: \"\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "  ai: null, // { panelId, threadId, selectedText }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "};"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "// localStorage 键：上次会话 + 用户命名的标签书签 + AI 分析记录"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "const LS_SESSION = \"smartcode-browser-session-v1\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "const LS_BOOKMARKS = \"smartcode-browser-bookmarks-v1\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "const LS_AI = \"smartcode-browser-ai-v1\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "const el = {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "  projectSelect: document.getElementById(\"project-select\"),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": ","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "};"
          }
        ],

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"代码浏览器的语言无关数据模型。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "这些 dataclass 是引擎、适配器、Web API 之间的统一契约。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "之所以独立出来，是为了让「C 的函数」「Scala 的 def/class」「Verilog 的 module」"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "都能用同一套结构表达，从而前端和 API 完全不必感知语言差异。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "所有行号均为 **1-based**（与编辑器、内核源码行号一致），列号同样 1-based。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "@dataclass"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "class Symbol:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "    \"\"\"一个「可导航单元」的定义。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "    在不同语言里它可能是函数、方法、类、模块等，用 &#96;&#96;kind&#96;&#96; 区分。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "    它是符号索引的基本条目，也是用户能在 Panel 中打开的目标。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "    \"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "    name: str"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "    kind: str  # function / method / class / object / struct / module ..."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    file: str  # 相对项目根的路径"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    start_line: int"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    end_line: int"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    signature: str = \"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    # 紧邻定义上方的文档注释（如内核 /** */），便于 Panel 顶部展示"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    doc: str = \"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    # 是否为「空实现/桩」（如内核 #ifndef 下的 static inline foo(void) { }）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "    # 解析候选排序时把空桩排到最后，优先指向真正的实现。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "    empty: bool = False"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    def to_dict(self) -\u003e dict:"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "        return asdict(self)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "@dataclass"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "class Reference:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "    \"\"\"函数/方法体内的一个调用点（被调符号出现的位置）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "    它只描述「在源码哪一行哪一列出现了名为 name 的调用」，"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "    解析到具体定义是索引层的职责（见 Definition / resolve）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "    "
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 55
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./src/smartcode_browser/models.py",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.19807089865207672
    },

      "codeBlock": {

            "text": "  \u003clink rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/static/style.css\" /\u003e"

            "text": "  \u003c!-- 顶栏：项目选择 + 符号搜索 --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "  \u003cheader class=\"topbar\"\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "    \u003cdiv class=\"brand\"\u003eSmartCode\u003cspan\u003e· 级联代码浏览器\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/div\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "    \u003cdiv class=\"controls\"\u003e"
          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"跨文件符号索引。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "职责：扫描一个项目的源码，提取所有可导航单元（Symbol），建立两张表："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;by_name&#96;&#96;：name -\u003e [Symbol]，用于把「引用」解析到「定义」（可多候选）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- &#96;&#96;by_file&#96;&#96;：file -\u003e [Symbol]，用于反查「某一行属于哪个符号」"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "索引是**惰性构建 + 内存缓存**：首次访问时扫描一次，之后命中缓存。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "大库（如内核全树）应通过项目的 include_paths 限定范围，避免扫描爆炸。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "import os"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "import re"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "import subprocess"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "import threading"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "from pathlib import Path"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "from .adapters import LanguageAdapter, get_adapter"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "from .index_cache import file_stamp, save as save_index_cache, try_load as try_load_index_cache"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "from .models import Symbol"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "from .registry import Project"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "# 单个项目索引的文件数量上限，超过则截断并告警，防止误把超大库全量扫描"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "_MAX_FILES = 20000"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "# 全局回退搜索时，最多解析的候选文件数（grep 命中后逐个 tree-sitter 确认）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "_MAX_GLOBAL_FILES = 40"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "# 合法标识符（防止把任意字符串拼进 grep 正则）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r\"^[A-Za-z_]\\w+$\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "class SymbolIndex:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    \"\"\"单个项目的符号索引。\"\"\""
          }
        ],

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "def create_app(engine: CodeEngine | None = None) -\u003e FastAPI:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "    \"\"\"构造 FastAPI 应用。engine 可注入，便于测试。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "    engine = engine or CodeEngine()"

            "text": "    app = FastAPI(title=\"SmartCode 代码浏览器\", version=\"0.1.0\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "    @app.get(\"/api/projects\")"
          },

            "text": "    def list_projects() -\u003e list[dict]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "        \"\"\"列出所有可浏览项目（供顶部下拉框）。\"\"\""
          },
          {

            "text": "        return engine.list_projects()"
          },

            "lineNumber": 48
          },

            "text": "    @app.get(\"/api/stats\")"
          },

            "text": "    def stats(project: str = Query(...)) -\u003e dict:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "        \"\"\"返回项目索引统计（会触发惰性索引构建，首次可能较慢）。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "        try:"
          },

            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "            return engine.project_stats(project)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "        except KeyError as exc:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "    @app.get(\"/api/search\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "    def search("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "        project: str = Query(...),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "        q: str = Query(..., min_length=1),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "        limit: int = Query(40, ge=1, le=200),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "    ) -\u003e list[dict]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "        \"\"\"按名称模糊搜索符号；支持 &#96;&#96;in:\u003c路径\u003e \u003c名\u003e&#96;&#96; 限定文件范围。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64,
            "text": "        try:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "            return engine.search(project, q, limit)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "        except KeyError as exc:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "    @app.get(\"/api/symbol\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "    def open_symbol("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "        project: str = Query(...),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "        file: str = Query(...),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "        name: str | None = Query(None),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "        line: int | None = Query(None),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "    ) -\u003e JSONResponse:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "        \"\"\"打开一个符号，返回 Panel 所需的源码与可点击引用。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "        try:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "            detail = engine.open_symbol(project, file, name=name, line=line)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "        except KeyError as exc:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc"
          },
          {

            "text": "        if detail is None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"未找到符号或源码不可读\")"

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "    @app.get(\"/api/resolve\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86,
            "text": "    def resolve("
          },
          {

            "text": "        project: str = Query(...),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "        name: str = Query(...),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "        from_file: str = Query(\"\"),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "    ) -\u003e list[dict]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "        "
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {

          }

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "class SymbolIndex:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    \"\"\"单个项目的符号索引。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "    def __init__(self, project: Project, project_id: str = \"\") -\u003e None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "        self.project = project"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "        self.project_id = project_id or project.root.name"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "        self._adapters = self._build_adapters(project)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "        self._by_name: dict[str, list[Symbol]] = {}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "        self._by_file: dict[str, list[Symbol]] = {}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "        self._built = False"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "        self._lock = threading.Lock()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "        self._file_count = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "        self._truncated = False"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "        self._from_disk_cache = False"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "        # 全局回退解析的结果缓存（含负缓存：值为空列表表示确实没找到）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "        self._global_cache: dict[str, list[Symbol]] = {}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "        self._global_lock = threading.Lock()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "    # --- 适配器选择 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "    @staticmethod"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "    def _build_adapters(project: Project) -\u003e list[LanguageAdapter]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "        \"\"\"主语言 + 附加语言，去重后返回适配器列表。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "        langs = [project.language, *project.extra_languages]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "        adapters: list[LanguageAdapter] = []"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "        seen: set[str] = set()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "        for lang in langs:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "            try:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "                ad = get_adapter(lang)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "            except KeyError:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "            if ad.name not in seen:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "                seen.add(ad.name)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "                adapters.append(ad)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "        return adapters"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "    def adapter_for(self, rel_path: str) -\u003e LanguageAdapter | None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "        \"\"\"按文件后缀选择负责的适配器。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "        for ad in self._adapters:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "            if ad.handles(rel_path):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "                return ad"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "        return None"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "    # --- 构建 ---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "    def _iter_source_files(self):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "        \"\"\""
          }
        ],

          "endPosition": {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"语言适配器接口。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "这是整个浏览器「语言无关」的关键抽象：引擎只与本接口打交道，"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "新增一种语言 == 实现一个子类，前端 / API / 索引 / 引擎均无需改动。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "适配器只负责「从源码里提取结构」，不负责跨文件解析（那是索引层的事），"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "职责单一便于各语言独立演进。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "from abc import ABC, abstractmethod"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "from ..models import Reference, Symbol"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "class LanguageAdapter(ABC):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "    \"\"\"单一语言的语法提取器。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "    子类需声明："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "    - &#96;&#96;name&#96;&#96;：语言标识（如 \"c\"）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "    - &#96;&#96;extensions&#96;&#96;：负责的文件后缀（含点，如 \".c\"）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "    - &#96;&#96;symbol_kinds&#96;&#96;：本语言「可导航单元」的种类，用于前端图标/说明"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "    并实现两个提取方法。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    \"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    name: str = \"base\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    extensions: tuple[str, ...] = ()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    symbol_kinds: tuple[str, ...] = ()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "    def handles(self, rel_path: str) -\u003e bool:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "        \"\"\"该文件是否归本适配器处理（按后缀判断）。\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "        lower = rel_path.lower()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "        return any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in self.extensions)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "    @abstractmethod"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,

          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\"浏览器内 AI 分析：直接调用 cursor-agent CLI（复用 Cursor 登录态，无需额外 API Key）。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2

          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "环境变量："

          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "  SMARTCODE_CURSOR_CLI_BIN   默认 cursor-agent（PATH 中查找）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "  SMARTCODE_CURSOR_MODEL     默认 composer-2.5"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "  SMARTCODE_CURSOR_TIMEOUT   单次分析超时秒数，默认 600"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "from __future__ import annotations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "import os"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "import shutil"

          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "from typing import Any"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "_SYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"你是 Linux 内核与系统软件代码分析助手。用户正在阅读源码，并选中了一段代码或整个函数。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "请基于提供的**完整函数上下文**和**选中片段**回答，重点："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "1. 若用户问时序/并发/多核/cache：列出几种可能情况（触发条件 → 路径 → 现象 → 如何验证）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "2. 引用具体变量、锁、barrier、per-CPU 语义"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "3. 不确定处明确标注假设，不要编造不存在的符号"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "4. 可用 mermaid flowchart/sequenceDiagram 辅助（语法正确）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "5. 回答使用中文，结构清晰，适度简洁\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "def _cli_bin() -\u003e str:"

          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    return ("

## 文档怎么用

- **一节 = 一页 PPT**：共 14 页标准版 + 附录（页序、每页标题、可选附录页）
- **不讲代码**：只讲问题、定位、交互、分层概念、多语言/多项目策略、大库场景决策、部署安全
- **突出 AI 故事**：第 9 页单独写「两重角色」——用 Cursor Agent **做出工具**，以及可选的 **函数级 AI 分析**（cursor-agent）

## 内容结构速览

| 页 | 主题 |
|----|------|
| 1–3 | 封面、痛点、产品定位（不是 IDE） |
| 4–5 | 级联交互 + 概念架构图（mermaid） |
| 6–8 | 语言无关、多项目注册、内核/大库产品决策 |
| 9 | **AI 辅助开发与内置分析** |
| 10–12 | 场景、部署安全、与 IDE/文档/Chat 对比 |
| 13–14 | 路线图、总结（级联 · 无关 · 可续） |

附录里有 **14 页标准页序**、**每页一句话标题**（方便套母版），以及可选的演示截图页 / FAQ 页建议。

若听众偏管理层，可删掉第 11 页（安全细节）或压缩第 6 页；若偏技术评审，可保留第 8、12 页。需要我按「10 分钟 / 20 分钟」再压一版精简提纲，或导出成 `.pptx` 大纲格式，可以说一下场合和时长。

## 时间怎么切（30 分钟）

| 模块 | 时长 | 内容 |
|------|------|------|
| 开场 | 2′ | 标题 + 今天路线 |
| 背景痛点 | 5′ | 读大库难题、现有方式不足、目标工作流 |
| 产品是什么 | 4′ | 定义、级联/无关/可续、能力表、避免误解 |
| **现场演示** | **10′** | 搜索 → 跟 2～3 层调用 → 变量/查用法 → 标签 → 刷新恢复 |
| 设计思路 | 5′ | 痛点↔设计、概念架构图、语言无关、大库取舍、部署安全 |
| AI | 2′ | AI 做出工具 + 可选函数问答 |
| 总结 | 2′ | 谁适合用、如何开始、三句话收尾 |

建议：**讲 PPT 约 20 分钟 + 演示 10 分钟**；Q&A 另留 5～10 分钟（文档里有常见问题预案）。

---

## 大纲里还包含什么

1. **20 页幻灯片清单**：每页标题 + 建议讲解分钟  
2. **每部分「讲什么」要点**：可直接当口播提纲  
3. **演示脚本 A（内核/C）**：逐步操作表 + 话术 + 风险备选  
4. **演示脚本 B（Scala/芯片）**：听众偏硬件时用  
5. **概念架构 mermaid 图**：设计段用，仍不讲代码  
6. **弹性裁剪**：25 分钟版 / 35～40 分钟版怎么加减  
7. **Q&A 表**：和 IDE、Sourcegraph、Cursor 依赖等  

短版 `PPT_设计思路.md`（7 页）仍保留，适合先发预览；做 30 分钟 PPT 以 **`PPT_30分钟介绍大纲.md`** 为主骨架即可。

若要我把某一段（例如演示 10 分钟）展开成**逐字讲稿**，可以说听众更偏内核还是芯片。
